events.verdict: Robinson III (DET) places a hand/arm to the front of Fournier (ORL) during his drive, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Griffin (DET) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Jackson (DET) uses his left arm to hook Fournier (ORL) during his drive, affecting his ability to defend.
LAR shows Drummond (DET) leans forward and makes incidental contact with Augustin's (ORL) arm with his head. The incidental contact from Drummond to Augustin does not affect his ability to pass.
Jackson (DET) briefly grasps Vucevic's (ORL) shorts and does not affect his ability to get to the pass.
Vucevic (ORL) shuffles his feet before starting his dribble.
Gordon (ORL) maintains legal guarding position throughout Griffin's (DET) drive.
Vucevic (ORL) establishes legal position in Robinson III's (DET) path and firms up on his right leg during the screen.
Gordon (ORL) beats Griffin (DET) to the spot and establishes legal guarding position when he absorbs the contact initiated by Griffin.
Fournier (ORL) makes incidental foot to foot contact to Griffin (LAC) after he throws the successful pass.
All technical fouls are reviewed by League Operations.
Ross (ORL) engages with Jackson (DET) but does not affect his FOM.
Gordon (ORL) commits a take foul on Robinson III (DET).
